async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Clear any existing filters to ensure a clean search
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Clear all').click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for filters to clear
    # Search for 'Nona Fitness Tank' in the product grid
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search by keyword').fill('Nona Fitness Tank')
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    # Wait for the search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Additional wait for dynamic content
    # After search, I need to check if product rows for 'Nona Fitness Tank' appear
    # This step doesn't involve further navigation yet; I'll handle in next action if needed.
